title: tragacantha glandulifera
intro: Tragacantha glandulifera, commonly known as Globe Thorn, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family Fabaceae. It is native to the Iberian Peninsula and is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Tragacantha glandulifera include wound healing, antimicrobial, and antiproliferative activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
